{{Top|fa}} {{Youmay|Comet the clone trooper|a [[comet]]}} {{Character |type=Galactic Republic |image=[[File:CometHS-PL.png]] |name=Comet |homeworld=[[Kamino]]''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know, Updated and Expanded]]'' — Based on corresponding data for [[Cloning|clones]] of [[Jango Fett]] |birth= |death= |species=[[Human]] {{C|[[Cloning|clone]]}} |gender=[[Gender|Male]]{{Rebels|A Fool's Hope}} |pronouns= |donor=[[Jango Fett]] |height=1.83 [[meter]]s {{C|6 [[Foot|ft]]}} |mass=80 [[kilogram]]s{{Topps|set=2015 Topps Star Wars Chrome Perspectives|subset=Jedi Temple Archives|cardname=Clone Troopers|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/114595/cid/8022627/2015-Topps-Chrome-Star-Wars-Perspectives-Jedi-vs.-Sith-23-J-Clone-Troopers}} — Based on corresponding data for [[Cloning|clones]] of [[Jango Fett]] |hair= |feathers= |eyes= |skin=[[Color|Tan]] |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=*[[Galactic Republic]]{{TCW|R2 Come Home}} **[[104th Battalion]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|Comet, let's go!|Commander Wolffe, to Comet|}} '''Comet''' was a [[Clone Corporal]] who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Serving under the command of [[Jedi General]] [[Plo Koon]] and [[Clone Commander]] [[Wolffe]], Comet was part of the [[clone trooper]] unit known as [[Wolfpack]]—a [[Republic Military|military]] unit that was part of the [[104th Battalion]]. Throughout the war, Comet served on many missions, working with fellow Wolfpack [[trooper]]s [[Boost]] and [[Sinker]] early in the war to [[Mission to Quarmendy|infiltrate]] the floating [[city]] known as the [[Nexus]] on the [[planet]] [[Quarmendy]] in [[22 BBY]], as well as performing a [[Mission to Vanqor|rescue mission]] on the planet [[Vanqor]] to save [[Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu]] and Jedi General [[Anakin Skywalker]] in [[21 BBY]]. Comet also fought in multiple larger conflicts, including the [[Second Battle of Felucia]] in [[20 BBY]] alongside Koon, Skywalker, and [[Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano]], and later the [[Battle of Kadavo]], helping to rescue the [[Togruta]]s of the [[artisan colony]]. Comet's service continued into [[19 BBY]], the last [[Standard year|year]] of the war, where they traveled to a [[Oba Diah moon|moon]] of the planet [[Oba Diah]] with Koon and the Wolfpack, searching for signs of the [[Death|deceased]] Jedi [[Sifo-Dyas]]. ==Biography== ===Early missions=== {{Quote|Great! If there's one thing worse than a clanker—it's a flying clanker!|Comet, while infiltrating the Nexus|[[Star Wars Adventures: The Clone Wars – Battle Tales 2|''Star Wars Adventures: The Clone Wars – Battle Tales'' 2]]}} Comet was created as a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[Cloning|clone]] of the [[bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett]] on the clone [[homeworld]] [[Kamino]], like all [[clone trooper]]s in the [[Grand Army of the Republic|Grand Army]] of the [[Galactic Republic]]. Comet served as a [[Clone Corporal]] in the [[104th Battalion]]'s [[Wolfpack]].{{TCW|Padawan Lost}} The [[battalion]] was led by [[Clone Commander]] [[Wolffe]] and{{TCW|Rising Malevolence|Rising ''Malevolence''}} [[Jedi High Council]] member''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]'' [[Jedi General]] [[Plo Koon]], fighting in the [[Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. [[File:WolfpackReady-TCWBattleTales2.png|thumb|left|325px|Comet and the Wolfpack]] In [[22 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' Comet and the Wolfpack battled [[Confederacy military|Separatist forces]] on the [[planet]] [[Quarmendy]]. Under the [[Commanding officer|command]] of [[Commander]] Wolffe, Comet accompanied Wolfpack [[trooper]]s [[Boost]] and [[Clone Sergeant]] [[Sinker]] and used [[JT-12 jetpack]]s to [[Mission to Quarmendy|infiltrate]] the [[Nexus]]—a floating [[city]] and trading outpost that was controlled by Separatist forces led by [[Emir]] [[Wat Tambor]]. The four [[Soldier|troopers]] were brought near the station in a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry|gunship]] flown by the [[Clone trooper pilot|clone pilot]] [[Corvis]] before they used their [[jetpack]]s to sneak toward it. The clones' initial approach was undetected, but they were soon attacked by a swarm of [[D1-series aerial battle droid]]s. They eventually prevailed, but, after their successful infiltration, Tambor opted to destroy the station instead of allowing it to fall into the Republic's hands. The four clones rescued a [[Orkle|hostage]] and tried to fly away, with Comet despairing that the blast radius was going to catch them. However, Koon arrived in another [[gunship]], saving the four troopers. Although they had failed to capture the station, Koon praised their efforts for rescuing a hostage and was appreciative that they had all survived. [[File:Comet_helping_windu.png|thumb|right|325px|Comet supporting Master Windu]] After the young [[bounty]] [[Hunting|hunter]] [[Boba Fett]] [[Sabotage of the Endurance|sabotaged]] the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Endurance]]'' in [[21 BBY]], Jedi Master [[Mace Windu]] and [[Jedi Knight]]''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]'' [[Anakin Skywalker]] landed on the planet [[Vanqor]] to search for any survivors of the [[Starship|ship's]] crew, particularly [[Admiral]] [[Shoan Kilian]] and Clone Commander [[Ponds]]. However, Fett and his allies, the bounty hunters [[Aurra Sing]], [[Bossk'wassak'Cradossk|Bossk]], and [[Castas]], were waiting for the [[Jedi]]. When a hidden explosive was detonated, fallen debris landed upon Windu and Skywalker. As the two lay trapped in the collapsing wreckage, Skywalker's [[R2-series astromech droid|astromech droid]], [[R2-D2]], returned to the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] on the planet [[Coruscant]] and informed both Koon and Skywalker's [[Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano]] of the two Jedi's current state. Koon, Tano, and the Wolfpack left to rescue the Jedi. On Vanqor, Koon and Tano held the ruined [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] of the Venator in place while Comet and Wolffe rushed to Skywalker and Windu's rescue, helping them into their gunship before the Venator fell apart and was destroyed. ===Felucia=== {{Quote|Stay alert, men. Let's move.|Comet, leading a squad with Ahsoka Tano toward the Separatist base|}} [[File:CometFelucia-TCW-PadawanLost.png|thumb|left|375px|Comet advances through the Felucian jungle]] In [[20 BBY]], Comet fought in the [[Second Battle of Felucia]]. One [[Local day|evening]], [[Republic Military|forces]] led by Koon, Skywalker, and Tano approached a [[Separatist outpost (Felucia)|Separatist outpost]]. Koon decided to split their forces to make their attack, with Comet leading a group of clones, including Sinker and Boost, that accompanied Tano around the base's rear wall. As they neared the wall, Tano told Comet to stop and, after the [[corporal]] halted the [[troop]]s, Tano told them that she [[Force sense|sensed]] something nearby. Comet asked her if it was a [[droid]], but Tano replied that it was probably just an animal. Telling the men to remain alert, Comet and the troopers made their final approach to the wall and took cover at the [[tree]]line. As Skywalker and Koon made their frontal assault to draw the Separatists toward them, Comet and the others took out the sentry droids and successfully scaled the wall with [[ascension cable]]s. As Tano covered their backs, Comet and the men secured their position. Comet then told Tano to come up after them, and Tano reassured Comet that she was right behind them. However, when Comet turned away to continue moving, Tano was captured by the [[Trandoshan]] hunter [[Lo-Taren]]. Meanwhile, Comet and the men continued on, unaware that she had been captured. They fought [[battle droid]]s until they met up with Koon and Skywalker's forces in the center of the base. Skywalker complimented Comet before asking where Tano was, and the clone replied that she had been covering their flank. Realizing his Padawan was unaccounted for, Skywalker ordered Comet and the men to perform a perimeter sweep, during which they discovered that Tano was missing in action. Although Skywalker, Rex, and his men searched until the following [[Standard day|day]], Koon reminded Skywalker that they needed to return to Coruscant, saying that military intelligence could work on locating her. Thus, Comet and the rest of the Republic forces departed [[Felucia]]. Tano was later [[Battle on Wasskah|recovered]] on{{TCW|Wookiee Hunt}} the [[moon]] [[Wasskah]].''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' ===Searches and rescues=== [[File:WolfpackFiresCables-EFK.png|thumb|right|325px|Comet using a jetpack during the rescue]] Later that [[Standard year|year]], after the population of the planet [[Kiros]] was [[Slavery|enslaved]] by the [[Zygerrian Slave Empire]] and brought to a [[Kadavo slave processing facility|slave processing facility]] on the planet [[Kadavo]], Koon led the Wolfpack to attempt a [[Battle of Kadavo|rescue]] of them as well as Kenobi and Rex,{{TCW|Escape from Kadavo}} who had been captured in their [[Mission to Zygerria|mission]] to locate the enslaved [[Togruta]]s on{{TCW|Slaves of the Republic}} the planet [[Zygerria]]. Comet was part of a squad that used jetpacks to deploy ascension cables for the Togrutas to escape down and onto their [[Arquitens-class light cruiser|''Arquitens''-class light cruiser]], the ''[[Hand of Justice]]''.{{BuildFalconCite|60|Starship Fact File}} As the platform the Togrutas were standing on began to retract, multiple of them fell, with one of them being caught by Comet. When the survivors made it into the hangar of the cruiser, Comet and the other troopers helped them receive medical treatment. [[File:CometInTheSand-TLO.png|thumb|left|290px|Comet leading the search party]] In the last year of the war, [[19 BBY]], Comet and the Wolfpack traveled with Koon to the [[Oba Diah moon|moon]] of the planet [[Oba Diah]] to [[Mission to Oba Diah (Clone Wars)|locate]] a [[775519|shuttle]] that had belonged to Jedi Master [[Sifo-Dyas]]. As they conducted a search through the howling winds and dust, Comet used a [[comlink]] to attempt to contact the other search parties and tell them that they had not found anything. As Comet noted that they were probably way off from their target, Wolffe replied over the comm from a [[HAVw A6 Juggernaut|turbo tank]] that their data indicated that they were very close. Comet assured the commander that they had scoured the area three times but could not detect anything by visual or by using the scanner, declaring the area to be a wasteland. However, another trooper soon discovered the wreckage of the [[shuttle]]. Koon later reported their findings to the Jedi Council.{{TCW|The Lost One}} Later in 19 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]],"[[Neyo's Almanac of Clankers]]" establishes that it was written after the [[mission to Mokivj]], but while the [[Clone Wars]] was ongoing, which places it in [[19 BBY]] per ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''. Comet was mentioned in an intelligence report by Wolffe describing the D1-series aerial battle droid, which was included in the survival compendium "[[Neyo's Almanac of Clankers]]."{{GermanFanCite|118|Database}} ===Legacy=== {{Quote|The wolves! You got your Wolfpack back!"
"Yeah. They fight just like the boys.|Gregor and Wolffe, during the Battle for Lothal|}} In [[1 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of "[[A Fool's Hope]]" to [[1 BBY]]. Wolffe and former [[clone commando]] [[Gregor]] fought against the [[Galactic Empire]] during the [[Liberation of Lothal|liberation]] of the planet [[Lothal]]. During the conflict, Lothal's native [[Loth-wolf|loth-wolves]] joined the fight against [[Lothal garrison|Imperial forces]]. Observing the similarity between the wolves and the "Wolfpack" nickname for the squad in the 104th Battalion, Gregor commented that Wolffe had his Wolfpack back. Wolffe smiled and responded that they fought just like Comet and the other men. ==Personality and traits== Comet was a skilled and experienced soldier, serving in Commander Wolffe's Wolfpack. As a corporal, Comet was trusted to lead other troopers and did so capably. In addition to being relied upon by commanding officers Wolffe and Jedi Master Plo Koon, they were also trusted by Ahsoka Tano. As a clone of Jango Fett, Comet stood 1.83 [[meter]]s (6 [[Foot|feet]]) tall, weighed eighty [[kilogram]]s, and had tan skin. ==Equipment== [[File:CoburnWolfpack-EFK.png|thumb|right|300px|Comet wearing Phase II armor]] Comet had standard [[Phase I clone trooper armor]] with [[Color|reddish]] and eventually gray-blue markings consistent with the Wolfpack, including unique markings on their [[helmet]]. Comet's [[Phase II clone trooper armor|Phase II armor]] was also uniquely painted with gray-blue markings. During their mission to Oba Diah's moon, Comet wore sand-proof [[Clone trooper armor|armor]] designed for the harsh weather conditions that included unique helmets and [[kama]]s. Comet carried a standard [[DC-15A blaster carbine]] and also frequently used a jetpack during missions. Comet was also able to don a [[backpack]] and wield a [[Z-6 rotary blaster cannon]] or [[RPS-6 rocket launcher]].{{HotToysCite|set=Television Masterpiece Series|packtype=Sixth Scale Figure|pack=#142: 104th Battalion Wolfpack Clone Trooper|link=collectibles/star-wars-104th-battalion-wolfpack-clone-trooper-hot-toys-914066}} {{C|Deluxe version only}} Like all other clone troopers, Comet had a [[behavioral modification biochip]] implanted into their [[brain]] at birth by [[Kaminoan]] [[scientist]]s in order to ensure that they would be complicit in certain [[Executive Order Codes for the Grand Army of the Republic|orders]]. ==Behind the scenes== Comet first appeared in "[[R2 Come Home]]," the twenty-first episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''. The episode aired on [[April 30]], [[2010]].{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode221.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: R2 Come Home}} Like all other clone troopers in the series,{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news20091120.html|text=Dee Bradley Baker: From Clones to Queen Karina}} they were voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]]. In [[2025]], the deluxe version of [[Sideshow Collectibles]]' Sixth Scale "104th Battalion Wolfpack Clone Trooper" figure featured additional helmets that match Comet's Phase I and Phase II helmets, albeit with minor differences; the helmet fin on Phase I helmet is erroneously colored in the Wolfpack gray markings instead of being left white, and the grey and white colors of the Phase II helmet's "cheek" markings are inverted from how they should be. Promotional imagery of the figure depicts a backpack-donning Comet in Phase II armor on the planet [[Geonosis]] while armed with a RPS-6 rocket launcher. Other promotional images include the Phase II-equipped Comet wielding the RPS, and a Phase I-equipped Comet with the backpack and a Z-6 rotary blaster cannon. ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Comet}} *[[Star Wars Adventures: The Clone Wars – Battle Tales 2|''Star Wars Adventures: The Clone Wars – Battle Tales'' 2]] {{Flash}} *{{TCW|R2 Come Home}} {{1st}} *{{TCW|Citadel Rescue}} *{{TCW|Padawan Lost}} *{{TCW|Escape from Kadavo}} *{{TCW|The Lost One}} *{{Rebels|A Fool's Hope}} {{Imo}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/r2-come-home-episode-guide|text="R2 Come Home" Episode Guide | The Clone Wars}} *{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/padawan-lost-trivia-gallery|text="Padawan Lost" Trivia Gallery}} *{{SW|url=news/star-wars-battles-that-changed-the-galaxy-announce|text=In ''Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy'', Go Inside the Crucible of War}} *''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]'' *{{GermanFanCite|118|Database}} *{{HotToysCite|set=Television Masterpiece Series|packtype=Sixth Scale Figure|pack=#142: 104th Battalion Wolfpack Clone Trooper|link=collectibles/star-wars-104th-battalion-wolfpack-clone-trooper-hot-toys-914066}} {{C|Deluxe version only}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Comet |ja=コメット }} [[Category:Clone trooper corporals]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Members of the 104th Battalion]]
